body.name: nearbee-near
body.profile_yaml:
name: nearbee-near
description: Nearbee runs on NEAR AI Cloud TEE models (Confidential, owned by nearai)
executor:
  agent: opencode
  model: nearai/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
  fallbacks:
    - { agent: opencode, model: nearai/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 }
soul: any
environment: minimal
process_env:
  policy: allowlist
  allow: [NEARAI_API_KEY]
body.soul_md: Do exactly the task in the prompt and nothing else.
